verses.en: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,
verses.pt: E o anjo que falava comigo voltou e me despertou, tal como se desperta um homem de seu sono.
verses.en_web: The angel who talked with me came again, and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel who was talking to me came again, awaking me as a man out of his sleep.

verses.en: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
verses.pt: E ele me disse: O que vês? E eu respondi: Eis que vejo um castiçal de ouro maciço, com um recipiente de azeite sobre seu topo, e sete lâmpadas sobre ele; e cada uma das sete lâmpadas tinha um tubo em seu topo;
verses.en_web: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps, which are on the top of it;
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, I see a light-support, made all of gold, with its cup on the top of it and seven lights on it; and there are seven pipes to every one of the lights which are on the top of it;

verses.en: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
verses.pt: E duas oliveiras junto a ele, uma à direita do recipiente, e uma à esquerda.
verses.en_web: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
verses.en_bbe: And two olive-trees by it, one on the right side of the cup and one on the left.

verses.en: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
verses.pt: E eu perguntei ao anjo que falava comigo, dizendo: Meu senhor, o que é isto?
verses.en_web: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”
verses.en_bbe: And I made answer and said to the angel who was talking to me, What are these, my lord?

verses.en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.pt: E o anjo que falava comigo respondeu dizendo: Tu não sabes que é isto? E eu disse: Não, meu senhor.
verses.en_web: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the angel who was talking to me, answering me, said, Have you no knowledge of what these are? And I said, No, my lord.

verses.en: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: E ele falou comigo, dizendo: Esta é palavra do SENHOR a Zorobabel, que diz: Não se fará por força, nem por violência, mas sim por meu espírito, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel, saying, Not by force or by power, but by my spirit, says the Lord of armies.

verses.en: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
verses.pt: Quem és tu, montanha grande? Diante de Zorobabel se tornarás em planície; ele trará a pedra angular com gritos de: Graça! graça seja!
verses.en_web: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”
verses.en_bbe: Who are you, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel you will become level: and he will let all see the headstone, with cries of Grace, grace, to it.

verses.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: E palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.
verses.pt: As mãos de Zorobabel fundaram esta casa; também suas mãos a completarão, para que saibais que o SENHOR dos exércitos me enviou até vós.
verses.en_web: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.
verses.en_bbe: The hands of Zerubbabel have put the base of this house in place, and his hands will make it complete; and it will be clear to you that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.

verses.en: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
verses.pt: Pois quem despreza o dia das pequenas coisas? Pois esses sete se alegrarão ao verem o prumo na mão de Zorobabel (esses são os olhos do SENHOR, que percorrem toda a terra).
verses.en_web: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”
verses.en_bbe: For who has had a poor opinion of the day of small things? for they will be glad when they see the weighted measuring-line in the hand of Zerubbabel. Then he said in answer to me, These seven lights are the eyes of the Lord which go quickly up and down through all the earth.

verses.en: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
verses.pt: E eu respondi, perguntando: O que são as duas oliveiras à direita e à esquerda do castiçal?
verses.en_web: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
verses.en_bbe: And I made answer and said to him, What are these two olive-trees on the right side of the light-support and on the left?

verses.en: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
verses.pt: E também lhe perguntei: O que são aqueles dois ramos de oliveiras que estão de lado dos dois tubos de ouro que derramam azeite dourado?
verses.en_web: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts, that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”
verses.en_bbe: And answering a second time, I said to him, What are these two olive branches, through whose gold pipes the oil is drained out?

verses.en: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.pt: E ele falou comigo, dizendo: Tu não sabes o que é isto? E eu disse: Não, meu senhor.
verses.en_web: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said in answer to me, Have you no knowledge what these are? And I said, No, my lord.

verses.en: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the LORD of the whole earth.
verses.pt: Então ele disse: Estes são os dois ungidos que estão diante do Senhor de toda a terra.
verses.en_web: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, These are the two sons of oil, whose place is by the Lord of all the earth.
